concepts.title: 증착
concepts.classificationNote: 재료층을 형성하거나 처리하는 단위 공정이며 장비 제품은 실제 제품 사례로 구분한다. 동일 개념의 최종 분류는 문헌 간 통합 검토에서 확정했다.
concepts.summary: 반도체 소자를 구성하는 유전체 절연층과 금속 전도층을 형성하는 공정이다. 재료의 종류와 목표 구조에 따라 서로 다른 기법을 사용한다.
concepts.summaryEvidenceQuote: Deposition processes create layers of dielectric (insulating) and metal (conducting) materials used to build a semiconductor device. Depending on the type of material and structure being made, different techniques are employed. Electrochemical deposition (ECD) creates the copper “wiring” (interconnect) that links devices in an integrated circuit. Metal plating of copper and other metals is also used for through-silicon vias and wafer-level packaging applications. Tiny tungsten connectors and thin barriers are made with the precision of chemical vapor deposition (CVD) and atomic layer deposition (ALD), which adds only a few layers of atoms at a time. Plasma-enhanced CVD (PECVD), high-density plasma CVD (HDP-CVD), and ALD are used to form the critical insulating layers that isolate and protect all of these electrical structures. Pulsed laser deposition (PLD) is used to enable high performance piezoelectric layers. PLD is a physical vapor deposition method that uses high pulsed energy laser light to energize material, creating a deposition vapor that can be condensed on different substrates.

Plasma-enhanced CVD (PECVD), high-density plasma CVD (HDP-CVD), and ALD are used to form the critical insulating layers that isolate and protect all of these electrical structures. Pulsed laser deposition (PLD) is used to enable high performance piezoelectric layers. PLD is a physical vapor deposition method that uses high pulsed energy laser light to energize material, creating a deposition vapor that can be condensed on different substrates.

perspectiveCases.evidenceQuote: Lam Research hopes to revolutionize microchip manufacturing with the launch of a new system: Prestis™.
